title: OmniGenBench: Automating Large-scale in-silico Benchmarking for Genomic Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) across diverse, multi-species benchmark suites (RGB, PGB, GUE, GB) and applying sequence filtering tools (like cd-hit-est and blastn) to remove evolutionary conserved sequences, stress-testing models on underrepresented genomic domains and less-studied species.

Standardizing benchmark protocols, hyperparameter settings, data splits, and metric implementations within an automated pipeline (AutoBench) to eliminate performance variances and unfair comparisons caused by inconsistent evaluation environments or manual interventions.
